Priya Shah: FYI my corporate card was declined at a taxi in SIN last night so I paid the ride myself (driver gave an emailed receipt). The ride shows SGD 24 but my bank posted USD 17.50 due to DCC. Which amount should I claim?
Ethan W.: Sorry about the decline. For DCC cases we reimburse based on the amount you were actually charged by your bank (the post-transaction amount). Attach both the driver receipt and your card statement showing the USD charge.
Priya Shah: Uploads: https://img.redwood-internal/receipts/sin_taxi_receipt.jpg, https://img.redwood-internal/receipts/cc_statement_usd.jpg. Driver email doesn't show merchant tax ID.
Tom H. (Manager): I approve the reimbursement for the charged amount in USD. Please add a short note: "card declined, reimbursing bank charge".
Finance-Bot: Policy FIN-EXP-TRV-007: reimburse in the currency posted by the card for DCC transactions. If claiming foreign currency amount when bank fee or DCC applied, include FX evidence and bank posting. Attach both documents and select Expense type = "Transport - Taxi (DCC)".
Priya Shah: Submitted expense ID 2045501, Claiming USD 17.50, attached driver receipt + bank statement. Comment: "Tom H. approved".
AP-Bot: Expense 2045501 queued. Standard payment run next Friday. If you want immediate reimbursement, request manual AP and tag @ethan.
Priya Shah: All good with Friday. Thanks!
